subject: S20 landed (cfbdc54); unit/lint/vitest green; db + e2e unverified locally, CI pending
body:
S20 landed on claude/naadi-shared as 74c3f2e + cfbdc54 (migration 0023, single head 0017 -> 0022 -> 0023).

WHAT
- Anki (naadi_api/anki): .apkg reader for anki2/anki21/anki21b (stdlib zip+sqlite+zstandard, caps, read-only authorizer, unicase collation, protobuf manifest decoder), templates/cloze rendering, HTML->strict TipTap, images->WebP (private media_assets rows, owner_user_id), audio dropped+counted, idempotent by (owner, anki_guid), cards start new in FSRS. Export via genanki with stable GUIDs. Routes /api/anki/{import,export,decks}. Verified against real Anki-written packages (new + legacy) built in a throwaway venv (not added to the project).
- YouTube (naadi_api/youtube + graph youtube_map + cron Sun 05:17 UTC): official google-api-python-client, quota ledger, uploads playlist derived from channel id (no channels.list/search.list), offline fastembed scoring, refresh (25d) / drop+unlink+stale (30-day rule), candidates -> video_candidates. Queue API approve/reject/add_by_url + admin routes /api/admin/youtube/*. tools/youtube_mapper.py is now a thin CLI.
- Web: IFrame Player API behind S06's click-to-load facade (no request to YouTube before the click), chapters, speed, "Note at m:ss" notes (anchor_pos {t}, S13 outbox), YouTubePrivacyNotice (mounted on AccountPage), Anki import/export dialogs on the Cards screen, AnkiTile for S15's Library, CardOut.media for imported pictures.
- Notes: VideoPos {t} union added to notes/models.py (small, tests in tests/notes/test_video_pos.py).
- CSP: script-src now also allows https://www.youtube.com (IFrame API only); test added.

TESTS (local)
- lint, typecheck, vitest (393 web), pytest -m "not live and not db": 1042 passed. gen:contracts / gen:requirements / ui-copy defaults regenerated, no drift.
- NOT RUN LOCALLY: db tests and Playwright e2e. This sandbox has no Docker and its Postgres 16 lacks pgvector >= 0.7 (halfvec); building it was denied by the permission classifier, so I did not work around it. I wrote tests/anki/test_anki_db.py, tests/youtube/test_youtube_db.py, RLS coverage/live_check updates, and e2e specs video.spec.ts / anki.spec.ts, all UNVERIFIED until CI runs them. No screenshots taken (no stack). Smoke set 2x with --retries=0 therefore NOT done.
- CI: the run for cfbdc54 had not started when I checked (runs on this branch take ~40 min). Please treat db/e2e as open until it is green; I will watch the inbox and fix findings.

DECISIONS
- Migration renumbered 0018 -> 0023 (S15b took 0022 off 0017).
- media_assets.owner_user_id + RLS read policy (private pictures for imported cards); sources row 'user-upload' via migration.
- flashcards.tags/anki_guid/anki_note_type; unique (owner, anki_guid).
- Candidate PK is (media, section); reject is video-level and drops stored title at once.
- agent_health.kind += youtube_map. YoutubeRules in app_config 'youtube'; flag 'anki'.
- Import takes the raw request body (no multipart dependency), 100 MB cap.
- Imported cards are not editable in the app (RLS: students write origin 'user' only); a deck can be deleted via DELETE /api/anki/decks.
- S19: no queue hub exists yet; contract posted (list_candidates/approve/reject/add_by_url). S15: registries do not exist yet; extractor/placement hook not wired, same code reachable at POST /api/anki/import. S14: page context via window event naadi:video-position {media_id,t}. S21: mount YouTubePrivacyNotice in Settings.

CHECKLIST: copy keys (all ui_copy, required, defaults regenerated, copy-lint roots added) done; server responses are codes/counts done; secrets only via settings (youtube_api_key) done; free quota only done; RLS in same migration + coverage tests updated done; CSP change done; db tests / e2e / screenshots / local smoke x2: NOT verified (see above).
